details:
ASTROVITAL X – The Astronaut Health Intelligence System

1. Introduction

ASTROVITAL X is an independent student-developed web-based prototype designed to support astronaut health monitoring and mission awareness during space exploration.

2. Problem

Astronauts face unique health challenges during space missions, including changes in physical health, sleep, nutrition, hydration and the effects of microgravity. Monitoring crew health is an important part of planning safer missions.

3. Our Solution

ASTROVITAL X brings astronaut health information and mission-support features together in one interactive dashboard.

4. Main Features

- Mission health overview dashboard

- Individual astronaut crew profiles

- Simulated health indicators

- Smart health alerts

- Educational precaution centre

- Health insights and trend visualisation

- Mission reports and safety information

5. Innovation

The project combines crew profiles, health indicators, visual analytics and educational precaution guidance in a single space-themed interface.

6. Expected Impact

ASTROVITAL X aims to make astronaut health information easier to understand and support health awareness during long-duration space missions.

7. Future Improvements

Future development could include research-based data integration, more advanced analytics, improved testing and connections to validated monitoring systems.

8. Limitations

ASTROVITAL X is an independent prototype. All displayed crew information, health readings and alerts are simulated. It is not medically validated, does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment, and is not an official NASA product.
